query.comment: Check that the model can reach an accepting state
Verify that at least one spike event is possible
Verify that the system can return to a flat region after a spike
Verify that a flat region can exist before the first spike
Check that the initial flat region lasts at least flat_window time units
Check that the recovery flat region after a spike lasts at least flat_window time units
Check that a spike can last at least spike_window time units
Ensure that the model is deadlock-free in all reachable states

query.formula: A<> Automaton.S4 || Automaton.S5 || Automaton.S33 || Automaton.S12 || Automaton.S31 || Automaton.S78 || Automaton.S187
query.comment: Check that the model can reach an accepting state for all paths
Every execution eventually reaches a spike
Every execution eventually goes through a spike and reaches a recovery flat
Every execution eventually reaches an initial flat before spike
Every execution eventually has initial flat lasting at least flat_window
Every execution eventually has recovery flat lasting at least flat_window
Every execution eventually has a spike lasting at least spike_window

Probability that flat region lasts at least flat_window time units before a spike
